observations: body L2: «١٧٥ 15» stands between «١٥٦» and «١٤٣», out of the order of the list; transcribed as printed.
body L3, L4: the strokes printed above «der» and before «Sprachgebrauch» (L4) are the kasras below «بِأَثَرِ» and «بِإِثْرِ» (L3).
body L4: the title is printed «Das Sprachgebrauch»; Friedlaender's book is «Der Sprachgebrauch des Maimonides».
body L5: a short stroke is printed below the alif of «آحَادٌ»; not transcribed.
body L9, L10: the first «مُؤَخَّرُ» (L9) has a damma on the r, the second (at the end of L9, continued by «النهر» in L10) none; «مَصَبّ» (L9) has the shadda without a vowel.
body L19, L20, L21: the sign over the f of «أُفْقُ» (L19, L20) and «الافْقَانِ» (L21) is a sukūn (1.9-2.1 points wide; the dammas of these lines are 3.2-3.4), not a damma.
body L23: the sign over the shadda of «أَفُلَّن» is a fatha (3.9 by 2.0 points), the sign over its f a damma.
body L25: the second l of «nonnullos» is printed with a break in its stem, so that it resembles an i.
body L28: the zero of «٢٧٠» stands on the baseline, beside the point that follows it.
body L29: the dash after the headword «امر» is an en dash, half as long as the dashes of the other entries.
body L34: a comma and a semicolon are printed after «paen.».
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
